fields.Name: T335 - Scope Type Conditional Filter Input
fields.Description: Exercises the @if(Record.ScopeType==='Filter') conditional filter field and the ScopeType set() handler — a scope-selection branch distinct from the FieldRules builder.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open 'Bulk Operations', click 'New operation', and in the editor's '2 What it acts on' section find the 'Default scope' dropdown (options Filter / A view / A list). Confirm that when 'Filter' is selected a filter text input appears below the row (labelled 'Filter — overridden by the grid selection at run time'). Switch the Default scope to 'A view' or 'A list' and verify that the free-text Filter input is no longer shown; switch back to 'Filter' and confirm it reappears. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the filter input toggle with the scope selection is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: With 'Filter' scope selected, a free-text Filter input is shown
Switching to 'A view'/'A list' hides that Filter input, and switching back to 'Filter' restores it
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
